title: MOAH:CEDAR
venue_description:
MOAH:CEDAR - Lancaster Museum of Art and History Cedar Center

Historical Significance

The Cedar Center for the Arts is a restored historical building originally constructed in the 1920s and listed on the National Register of Historic Places. For nearly a century it served as the civil and social center of the Antelope Valley from the 1920s through the late 1950s housing the County Center sheriff's office health center and library. In recent years the center underwent major restoration to preserve its original Art Deco character and architectural significance.

Facility Overview

The newly restored complex comprises multiple distinct areas including the MOAH:CEDAR Art Gallery the Cedar Memorial Hall and dedicated arts classroom spaces. The facility is available for rental for private events while remaining a vibrant community cultural venue.

Performance and Music Programming

MOAH:CEDAR hosts regular Spotlight Cafe open mic nights held on the fourth Friday of each month from 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM. The monthly open mic features all genres including music poetry dance and performance art. All local talent is welcome with a five-minute limit per performer. Basic microphones and audio playback equipment are provided.

The Cedar Memorial Hall hosts a monthly Concert Series featuring local musicians and performers with free admission. The venue includes a Board Game Cafe and hosts live figure drawing sessions for community members of all skill levels.

Community Arts Programming

Beyond performance events MOAH:CEDAR offers free live figure drawing classes beginner sessions with clothed models held the second Sunday of each month. Zine workshops and art exhibitions run throughout the year. Young artist workshops designed for youth 17 and younger are held monthly on the second Thursday based on current gallery exhibitions.

Gallery Exhibitions

MOAH:CEDAR features rotating art exhibitions celebrating diverse media and artistic practices. The gallery space showcases local and emerging artists through carefully curated shows and special programming.

title: Big Shotz Bar & Grill
venue_description:
Big Shotz Bar & Grill

The AV's Home of Rock and Roll

Big Shotz Bar & Grill has earned its reputation as the premier live music venue in the Antelope Valley featuring rock and classic rock entertainment every Friday and Saturday night. Located in the heart of downtown Lancaster the venue showcases talented local and touring musicians to enthusiastic audiences.

Live Music Venue

The venue operates a dedicated stage with professional sound and lighting equipment. Friday and Saturday night performances feature a diverse lineup including rock bands tribute acts and local talent. The entertainment schedule celebrates classic rock contemporary hits and original music from Antelope Valley artists.

Food and Dining

Big Shotz offers a comprehensive menu featuring quality American fare. Specialties include authentic New York style pizza made from fresh ingredients and hand-tossed dough. The Italian menu includes pasta dishes lasagna and traditional recipes. The full menu also offers burgers wings salads appetizers and more. Regular specials include dollar wings on certain nights and five dollar spaghetti deals.

Full Service Bar

Fully stocked bar with competitive pricing on beer wine and cocktails. The venue features an extensive selection of beverages to accompany meals and entertainment.

Sports and Entertainment

Multiple large screens throughout the venue display NFL games all season with NFL Sunday Ticket. Broadcast coverage includes Los Angeles Dodgers baseball and major sporting events. The venue regularly features special events and themed entertainment nights beyond live music including karaoke and celebration events.

Venue Amenities

Large covered outdoor patio with comfortable seating for guests who prefer to enjoy meals and entertainment outside. Pool tables and gaming options provide additional entertainment. The spacious layout accommodates groups and celebrations with a welcoming community atmosphere. Professional staff dedicated to creating memorable experiences for patrons.

title: Lancaster Performing Arts Center
venue_description:
Lancaster Performing Arts Center

Premier Performance Venue

Opened in 1991 the Lancaster Performing Arts Center serves as the largest performing arts facility in the northern part of Los Angeles County known as the Antelope Valley. The state-of-the-art venue hosts diverse performances from national touring acts to local talent presentations.

2025-2026 Performance Season

The center unveiled a robust 2025-2026 season with over 35 performances including multiple genres. Notable performances include six-time GRAMMY Award winners Blind Boys of Alabama with Cory Henry Texican Rock artists Los Lonely Boys and the return of Black Violin blending classical and hip-hop music. Country music performances feature Mickey Guyton and The Frontmen with comedy showcases and family-friendly entertainment throughout the season.

Theater and Performance Space

The main stage theater seats 784 people with excellent acoustics and professional staging. The facility offers a premier environment for Broadway productions musicals dramas dance performances and lectures. Multiple performance spaces accommodate different event types and audience sizes.

Community Programming

The LPAC Arts for Youth program provides theatrical experiences for students with curriculum-based instruction and classroom study guides. Educational programming connects performances to student learning objectives and community education.

Ticket Packages and Pricing

Discount package programs include Pick 6 and Pick 10ticket packages offering 10 percent discount for 6-9 shows and 15 percent discount for 10 or more shows. Individual performance pricing varies based on event type and performer.
